auth.tagline: Tasks, records management, knowledge base and internal communications — in one place, for the fourteen staff of the NOC office.
auth.taglineShort: Tasks, documents and knowledge — in one place.
auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the Google work account issued on the olympic.kg domain.
auth.subtitleShort: Google work account on the olympic.kg domain
auth.popupHint: Nothing opened? Check whether your browser is blocking pop-ups.
auth.forgotText: The platform has no password of its own. Access is managed by Google Workspace — you can only reset it there.
auth.forgotTextShort: The platform has no password — access is managed by Google Workspace. Reset it there.
auth.noAccess: No access? Accounts are created by the administrator.
auth.deniedText: The account {{email}} does not belong to the olympic.kg domain. You can only sign in with a work account.
auth.deniedFooter: Work accounts are issued by the office administrator.
auth.deniedFooterShort: Work accounts are issued by the administrator.
auth.pendingBannerText: The administrator needs to assign you a role and a department. Until then, tasks, documents and the knowledge base are closed. This usually takes one working day.
auth.pendingBannerTextShort: The administrator needs to assign a role and a department. Until then, access is closed. This usually takes one working day.
auth.genericError: Could not sign in. Please try again.
